ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity (yellowish-white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark brown) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity anchor-shaped region extending from the peduncle into the median notch. The right lobe features a high-density cluster of small, low-intensity speckles on its distal half. The left lobe exhibits larger, diffused high-intensity geometric blobs with fewer distinct dark speckles.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 25-degree internal angle and a vertical depth of approximately 10-15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with frequent sharp peaks (5-15 pixel amplitude). A significant macro-indentation (tissue loss) is localized on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, terminating in sharp points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of small, dark circular spots on the interior distal region of the right lobe; sparse, high-intensity circular clusters (scars) on the left lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented high-intensity linear streaks visible on the mid-to-outer section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, non-uniform tissue loss or deep notches on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pixel tinting covering the majority of the high-intensity surfaces, contrasting with the pure black pigmentation of the center and edges.
